interface.name: list_brands
interface.title: List Store Brands
interface.description: Returns a paginated list of the brands registered in the store, each with its id, name, description and logo, optionally narrowed by a name keyword.
whenToUse: The merchant wants an overview of the brands they carry, e.g. 'which brands do I sell?'.
The merchant asks whether a particular brand exists in their store, e.g. 'do I have Zara?' -- filter with the keyword argument.
An agent needs a brand id before filtering or creating products for that brand.
The merchant wants to audit brand presentation, e.g. which brands are missing a logo or a description.
whenNotToUse: The merchant named ONE specific brand and wants its full record -- use get_brand with the brand id instead.
The merchant wants the products belonging to a brand rather than the brands themselves -- use list_products filtered by brand instead.
The merchant is asking about product categories rather than brands -- use list_categories instead.

page.description: Pagination page number. The response returns one page of brands; increment to fetch the rest.

keyword.description: Filter brands to those whose name matches this keyword.

id.description: The brand id, used by sibling brand and product tools.

name.description: The brand's display name, in the store's own language.

description.description: The brand's description as shown in the storefront; null when the merchant has not written one.

logo.description: URL of the brand's logo image; null when the brand has none.

banner.description: URL of the brand's banner image; null when the brand has none.

en_char.description: The brand's Latin-script name, used for alphabetical browsing when the name itself is in Arabic.

http.summary: List Brands -- list all brands related to your store, filterable by a keyword matching brand names.

query.name: keyword
query.description: A keyword to filter brands by a specific name.

statuses.meaning: The store's access token is missing or does not carry the brands.read scope, so the brands cannot be read until the app's authorization is fixed.

rules.message: keyword must contain at least one non-whitespace character; omit it entirely to list every brand
